opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary personal product haul, introducing beauty purchases and discussing items such as a Real Techniques set and Prada fragrance. The products were purchased with the speaker's own money, and the description expressly states that the video was not sponsored. Although the description promotes affiliate links and cashback, it discloses that commissions do not affect recommendations and identifies the links as commission-generating. Nothing described includes deceptive terms, guaranteed earnings, required payment, or a harmful outcome.

citations.quote: Hey guys, it's Dreya's, so today I have another haul for you
This is not a sponsored video. All products were purchased with my own $$.
Most links provide me with a commission, this makes no difference to whether or not I recommend a product.
I got the Real Techniques set here which is $20
This is Prada candy gloss fragrance.
